items.title: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results: HyPLM-Flash weights
items.summary_en:
FP32 weights of HyPLM-Flash (2.61 GB), split into two shards.

Download and merge:

```bash
for p in part0 part1; do
  curl -fL -o model.safetensors.$p https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/releases/download/hyplm-flash-weights/model.safetensors.$p
done
cat model.safetensors.part0 model.sa
